translation.name: Anututane Wam Kwikwiu Kayuk Kaknga Jesu Kraisda Takepbut Taknga Anin gatu Sam Kuupbam Lotutane Kap Taknga

content: Kau aaknga Devitda matakut. Miti yot gwene kopnangge taikaing.

content.text: Naat aminu kundu Buyambam tapatane yotna buyambam gwene kuna ngang nanikingkat
unekan gatake kuke musip gwaang siknga natapbumang.
itane daman gwen yapbike yoon saak yuamang.
Isreldane dongu Buyambam tapae gaak ininangge une kokaing.
Tupa gata unzing tasiningge gwa yaniwi kekekakut.
kingu Devitdane dongune nanata undang yuke wamu natake papan nomatakaing.
Ginu tumuk wam yake Jerusalem nanata kwikwiknga yutningge yanong.
Ginda anzing yanong, “Aminbamu Jerusalemde take siknga nataaingu take yutning,” ngang yanong.
Yake aminu damanda takumbasiwan Jerusalem patang banakan yutningu amaknga wena take yutningge tumuk wam yanong.
Ngan, king kapaat gatu tupan aminu une nana ngangu take yutning.
Na notnaat gatu akgatangamukaing katde natake nata Jerusalemde anzing yawit,
“Ga amaknga wena take yuyo,” ngang yawit.
Na Anutu, Buyambam tapanindane yotna buyambam gwende natanggamatake
nata tumuk wam yawa you wanggapmatane sangabamu takekan yutning.
